name: Execute Banner Job OSHA Report Pipeline
description: This pipeline executes the PEROSHA Banner job to generate OSHA Form 300 work-related injury reports for a specific employer code and date range, then outputs the report to a downloadable file.

parameters.name: ethosApiKey
parameters.label: Ethos API Key
parameters.description: The Ethos API key used to authenticate with Banner for job execution.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.label: Report Start Date
parameters.description: The start date for the OSHA report period (format: DD-MMM-YYYY, e.g., 01-JAN-2024).

parameters.name: stopDate
parameters.label: Report Stop Date
parameters.description: The stop date for the OSHA report period (format: DD-MMM-YYYY, e.g., 31-DEC-2024).

parameters.name: employerCode
parameters.label: Employer Code
parameters.description: The employer code to filter employee records (e.g., BU for main university).

pipeline: Execute Banner Job - Run PEROSHA Report
File Writer - Save Report to File

Execute Banner Job - Run PEROSHA Report.description: Executes the PEROSHA Banner job to generate OSHA Form 300 work-related injury and illness data for the specified date range and employer code.

JavaScript Transform - Format Report Out.description: Transforms the PEROSHA job output by joining the report array into a single formatted text string for file output.

File Writer - Save Report to File.description: Writes the formatted OSHA report to a downloadable text file with a pre-signed URL for easy access.
